# Video Reader
English · 中文
A DeepSeek Harness plugin that lets the agent **watch, listen to, and look at** things: video/audio
files on disk, and the live desktop. Everything runs locally — no upload, no cloud API.

- `video_read` — metadata, frames, subtitles, multilingual speaker-labelled transcript
- `video_fram

es` — full-width stills at exact instants
- `screen_capture` — look at the screen; every captured fr

ame is returned, in pages
- `screen_frames_read` — continue reading a capture until nothing is unrea

d
- `screen_watch` — sample continuously, wake the agent only when the picture changes
- `screen_rec

ord` — long captures as video (1 h at 30 fps ≈ 350 MB)
- `video_reader_setup` — check or install the
external toolchain (auto-installed on first use)

**Dependencies are installed automatically.** The first `video_read`/`video_frames`/`screen_capture`

call downloads whatever is missing (ffmpeg first) into `%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh-video-reader\bin`
and `…

\models`, then retries the call. Every download is pinned by version and verified
by sha256 against

the manifest in `lib/deps.js`; a mismatching file is deleted, never
installed. `scripts/setup.ps1` i

s now only a way to pre-seed everything up front.
Control the behaviour with the plugin Config (`aut

oSetup`, `autoSetupModels`,
`dependencyMirror`) or from Settings → Video Reader → Dependencies.
| Piece | Size | Why not committed |

| ffmpeg + ffprobe (essentials 9.0.2) | ~200 MB | per-file GitHub limit is 100 MB |
| whisper.cpp CL

I + DLLs (b5454) | ~10 MB | fetched with the rest |
| sherpa-onnx diarization runtime (v2.0.0) | ~17

MB | fetched with the rest |
| `ggml-medium-q5_0.bin` speech model | 514 MB | far above the limit |
| pyannote segmentation + 3D-Speaker embedding | ~33 MB | fetched with the rest |
**Design notes worth knowing**

- Long captures are recordings, not frame piles: one hour at 30 fps is 108,000 frames,
which only ma

kes sense as a video the reader samples afterwards.
- `screen_capture` never samples down. It keeps

every frame, writes a `manifest.json`,
attaches a batch, and tells you exactly how many frames are s

till unread.
- Window capture crops the composed desktop by the window's bounds: GDI cannot read the

D3D surface of a hardware-composited window, so `gdigrab -i title=` returns black frames.
- `screen

_watch` compares a 64×40 grayscale sample (2,560 bytes) and only spends a
full-size frame and a wake
-up when the change exceeds the threshold.

### 依赖：首次使用自动补齐（1.8 起）
`tools/`、`models/` 不入库，插件会自己补齐：
- 首次需要时（`video_read` / `video_frames` / `screen_capture`）自动把缺的组件下到 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh-video-reader\

{bin,models}`，装好再继续本次调用；
- 每个文件都按 `lib/deps.js` 里钉死的版本与 sha256 校验，校验失败的文件直接丢弃、不会安装；
- GitHub 域名不可达时默

认走 `gh-proxy.com` 镜像（`dependencyMirror`）；
- 设置页「依赖组件」可看状态、手动安装、关掉自动安装；
- 也可以用工具 `video_reader_setup`
显式检查/安装，或提前跑 `scripts/setup.ps1`。
## 工具
### `video_reader_setup`
| 参数 | 说明 |

| `action` | `status`（只读报告）或 `install`（下载缺失组件） |
| `components` | `ffmpeg` `whisper` `whisper-model`

`sherpa` `diarization-models`，或简写 `models` / `binaries` / `all`（默认） |
| `mirror` | GitHub 下载是否优先走 g

ion-models`，或简写 `models` / `binaries` / `all`（默认） |
| `mirror` | GitHub 下载是否优先走 gh-proxy 镜像；默认取设置页 |
返回每一项的就绪状态、安装位置、版本，以及安装耗时/体积。视频类工具在缺依赖时会先自动安装再继续，所以这个工具主要用于提前体检或重试失败的下载。
### `video_read`
| 参数 | 说明 |

| `path` | 视频/音频路径，绝对或相对会话工作目录 |
| `frames` | 抽帧数量，默认 12，0–40，`0` 只要元数据/转写 |
| `mode` | `even`（默认）或

`scenes`（按镜头切换） |
| `start` / `end` | 只看某段，支持 `90`、`1:30`、`00:01:30` |
| `transcript` | 是否转写，默认 true

|
| `language` | 强制语种，如 `zh` `en` `de` `ja` `ko` `fr` `ru`；默认 `auto` 自动识别 |
| `speakers` | 已知说话人数（0

= 自动推断）；给出时聚类更稳 |
| `diarize` | 是否标说话人，默认 true |
| `subtitles` | 是否提取内嵌/同名字幕，默认 true |
| `width` |
单帧宽度，默认 960，0 = 原尺寸 |
输出现场：
[代码示例省略，未执行]
拼版图片会作为图片内容直接进模型上下文（每格左上角烧入时间码），同时给出每帧全尺寸图路径。
### `video_frames`
按时间点抓全宽大图，一次最多 8 张，用于复查细节。
### `screen_capture`
看一眼**当前桌面**（实时屏幕），不是磁盘上的文件。
| 参数 | 说明 |

| `seconds` | 抓取窗口秒数，0 = 单张截图，最大 30 |
| `fps` | 采样帧率 1–30（默认取自设置页）。实测 2560×1600 下 gdigrab 能稳定跑到 ~28

fps、上限 ~56 fps；单次抓取总帧数封顶 240 |
| `region` | `full` / `window:<标题片段>` / `x,y,w,h`；不传则用设置页的默认值 |
| `fr

ames` | 拼版最多保留几帧（默认 12） |
| `width` | 每帧宽度 |
| `mouse` | 是否把鼠标指针画进去 |
返回同样是一张可直接看的拼版 + 每帧路径。**抓取是采样**：模型看到的是这 N 秒内实际存在的若干帧，不是持续视频流——所谓“实时看视频”，就是“按 2–5 fps 采样一段时间”。
## 屏幕捕获设置页
Web UI 里 **设置 → 视频阅读器** 提供图形化配置：允许/禁止抓屏、整屏 / 指定窗口 / 自定义区域、帧率、默认时长、每帧宽度、是否包含鼠标指针，并带「抓一帧预览」按钮直接确认范围。
